parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, top, bottom, and back.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and doors, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Shelf 1
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal plywood panel inside the cabinet used for supporting stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet interior into compartments for organized storage.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or sometimes adjustable but generally non-moving during use.

parts.name: Shelf 2
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of plywood, similar to other shelves in the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed in the middle section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary or adjustable depending on design.

parts.name: Shelf 3
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf panel located in the upper-middle section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for medium-sized items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Shelf 4
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf panel located near the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports lighter or less frequently accessed items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 5
parts.Basic_description: The topmost shelf of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the highest storage level for lightweight or rarely used items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not designed for movement.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 1
parts.Basic_description: A front door panel made of MDF, attached to the cabinet frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the contents of the cabinet while allowing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 2
parts.Basic_description: A lower front door panel made of MDF, similar to the upper door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage compartment of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on hinges.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 3
parts.Basic_description: A right-side upper door panel made of MDF.
parts.Functional_description: It conceals the upper right storage area and allows access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates on hinges for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 4
parts.Basic_description: A right-side lower door panel made of MDF.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the lower right compartment of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on hinges.
